scale.note: Draw a prop at displayWidth = px[0] / render_px_per_game_px game pixels. Characters are rendered character_world_scale times larger than life on purpose.

normal_maps.space: camera space, which for a straight-down camera is the sprite's tangent space
normal_maps.convention: OpenGL: red = +x (screen right), green = +y (screen up, north), blue = towards the viewer. (128, 128, 255) is a flat upward face.
normal_maps.note: If the game's y axis points down (Phaser), flip the green channel or invert the light's y when sampling.

facing: Characters face +x (screen right) at frame rotation 0, matching Phaser's zero angle. Props keep the kit's own orientation unless rotation_deg says otherwise.
lighting: Colour passes use a neutral white sky and a soft white sun 12 degrees north of vertical, with ambient occlusion baked in. No coloured light is baked; the game adds it.
licence_note: Every source is CC0 1.0. CREDITS.md carries the same provenance in the repo's SBOM format.
